<div class="card-body">
'''LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">LIN-V8K（エルアイン・ヴィーエイトケイ）</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">地雷を敷設できる。また、ターン中の好きな時に、１フォース消費して同じ位置カードにある地雷を１つ“無効化”（ロスト）させられる。</span><ref name="jp1-face" /><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-lin-v8k-elleyein-veeatekay-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay) (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-LIN-V8K-Elleyein-Veeatekay-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">代表的な地雷敷設／爆破用装甲ドロイド。軍事目的に転用された。地雷や爆薬を仕掛けたり除去したりする。このＬＩＮ－Ｖ８Ｋはジャワに再改造されたもの。</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''English reading aid (AI translation)'''

'''Lore:''' A typical armored droid for laying mines and demolition, adapted for military use. It lays and removes mines and explosives. This LIN-V8K has been modified again by Jawas.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Game text:''' Can lay mines. Also, at any time during a turn, may use 1 Force to ‘disable’ (lose) one mine at the same location card.<ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
